frontmatter.description: Turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character. Finds a direction from the product itself, then fixes spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion in that order, and can generate a real hero visual with an image tool when one is available. Use when the user asks to unslop, polish, clean up or redesign a screen so it stops looking AI-generated, or when a UI shows the usual tells like purple gradients, glows, gradient text, emoji labels, "New ✨&q
